cards.ex: The network really talked up the new anchor, but I'm not impressed.
cards.exUz: Kanal yangi boshlovchini juda maqtab gapirdi, lekin meni qoyil qoldirmadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani yoki odamni juda yaxshi deb ta'kidlash, maqtab gapirish.

cards.ex: I need to review the source material before writing the article.
cards.exUz: Maqola yozishdan oldin manba materialni ko'rib chiqishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumot olinadigan asl manba, hujjat yoki materiallar to'plami.

cards.ex: The campaign isn't getting much traction online.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya internetda unchalik ommalashmayapti.
cards.uzDef: G'oya yoki xabar ommabop bo'lishi, e'tiborni tortishi.

cards.ex: The article presents a slanted view of the situation.
cards.exUz: Maqola vaziyatga bir tomonlama qarashni taqdim etadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga adolatsiz, bir tomonni afzal ko'rgan holda qarash.

cards.ex: I try to stay informed by reading news from different sources.
cards.exUz: Men turli manbalardan yangiliklarni o'qib, xabardor bo'lishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: So'nggi voqealar va yangiliklardan doimiy xabardor bo'lib turish.

cards.ex: The trial sparked a media frenzy.
cards.exUz: Sud jarayoni ommaviy axborot vositalarining o'ta hayajonini keltirib chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Voqea atrofida ommaviy axborot vositalarining juda katta qiziqishi va hayajoni.

cards.ex: The story went through a thorough vetting process before publication.
cards.exUz: Hikoya nashr etilishidan oldin puxta tekshirish jarayonidan o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumot yoki shaxsni diqqat bilan tekshirish jarayoni.

cards.ex: Politicians live their lives in the public eye.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchilar hayotlarini jamoatchilik nazarida o'tkazadilar.
cards.uzDef: Jamoatchilikning e'tibori markazida bo'lish, hamma tomonidan ko'rilish.

cards.ex: The company issued a press release about the new product.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi mahsulot haqida press-reliz chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy axborot vositalari uchun rasmiy bayonot.

cards.ex: The PR team is in damage control mode after the scandal.
cards.exUz: PR jamoasi janjaldan keyin zararni bartaraf etish rejimida.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yaxshilash uchun harakat qilish, salbiy oqibatlarni kamaytirish.

cards.ex: The news program was full of talking heads offering their opinions.
cards.exUz: Yangiliklar dasturi o'z fikrlarini bildiruvchi gapiruvchi boshlarga to'la edi.
cards.uzDef: Televizorda gapiradigan ekspert yoki sharhlovchi.

cards.ex: The anniversary of the event is a good news peg for a story.
cards.exUz: Voqeaning yilligi hikoya uchun yaxshi yangiliklar asosi.
cards.uzDef: Yangiliklar qilinadigan voqea yoki mavzu.

cards.ex: The reporters were trying to dig up dirt on the politician.
cards.exUz: Reportyorlar siyosatchi haqida kompromat qidirishga harakat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishi haqida salbiy ma'lumotlarni topishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: It's hard to filter out the fake news from the real news.
cards.exUz: Soxta yangiliklarni haqiqiy yangiliklardan saralab olish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz yoki noto'g'ri ma'lumotlarni olib tashlash.

cards.ex: The interview gave the conspiracy theory some legs.
cards.exUz: Intervyu fitna nazariyasini ommalashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror g'oyani tarqatish, ommalashtirish, rivojlantirish imkoniyatini berish.

cards.ex: The company is trying to improve its public perception.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya jamoatchilik fikrini yaxshilashga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Jamoatchilikning biror narsa haqidagi fikri yoki tushunchasi.

cards.ex: The magazine is going to print tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Jurnal ertaga chop etiladi.
cards.uzDef: Nashr etish uchun bosmaxonaga yuborilmoq (kitob, gazeta va hokazo).

cards.ex: All articles are fact-checked before they are published.
cards.exUz: Barcha maqolalar nashr etilishidan oldin faktlar tekshiriladi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotlarning to'g'riligini tekshirish.

cards.ex: The event received extensive press coverage.
cards.exUz: Voqea keng matbuot yoritilishiga sazovor bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Voqea haqida matbuotda berilgan xabarlar va maqolalar.

cards.ex: The politician is a master of spin control.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi tushuntirish ustasi.
cards.uzDef: Salbiy xabarni ijobiy ko'rsatishga urinish.

cards.ex: The scandal became headline news around the world.
cards.exUz: Janjal butun dunyo bo'ylab asosiy yangilikka aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Eng muhim va e'tiborga molik yangilik.

cards.ex: The controversial statement caused a media storm.
cards.exUz: Bahsli bayonot ommaviy bo'ronga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Voqea atrofida ommaviy axborot vositalarining kuchli va kutilmagan qiziqishi.

cards.ex: The official spoke to reporters on background.
cards.exUz: Rasmiy vakil reportyorlar bilan manbani oshirmasdan gaplashdi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumot beriladi, lekin manba oshkor qilinmaydi.

cards.ex: The company is focused on damage limitation after the PR disaster.
cards.exUz: PR falokatidan keyin kompaniya zararni cheklashga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Salbiy oqibatlarni kamaytirish uchun qilingan harakatlar.

cards.ex: The article slipped through without proper editorial oversight.
cards.exUz: Maqola tegishli muharrir nazoratisiz o'tib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Nashr etilishidan oldin matnni muharrir tomonidan tekshirish va tasdiqlash jarayoni.

cards.ex: The story was picked up by several news outlets.
cards.exUz: Hikoyani bir nechta yangiliklar nashrlari olib ketishdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangiliklarni tarqatuvchi tashkilot (gazeta, televideniye, veb-sayt).

cards.ex: The journalist pushed back against the accusations.
cards.exUz: Jurnalist ayblovlarga qarshilik ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qarshi chiqish, norozilik bildirish.

cards.ex: We guarantee source confidentiality to protect our informants.
cards.exUz: Ma'lumot beruvchilarimizni himoya qilish uchun manba maxfiyligini kafolatlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Axborot bergan shaxsning shaxsini sir saqlash.

cards.ex: Let's go off the record for a moment so I can be frank.
cards.exUz: Keling, bir daqiqa norasmiy gaplashaylik, shunda men ochiq bo'lishim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ommaga e'lon qilinmaydigan ma'lumotni berish.

cards.ex: The documentary was a hard-hitting expose of corruption.
cards.exUz: Hujjatli film korrupsiyani keskin fosh etdi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq va ochiqchasiga tanqid qiluvchi yoki ta'sir qiluvchi.
